visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an exterior shot of the Taipei Station West Underground Parking Lot entrance. A white Honda CR-V is idling in a queue on a paved road under an overcast sky. Large blue and yellow signs indicate parking directions and lane types. High-density text overlays in white and yellow occupy the center of the frame, explaining the situation. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a vehicle, focusing on a young woman in the passenger seat. She has long, straight hair and wears a distinctive white fuzzy bear-eared hat over a beige coat. She looks toward the camera with a playful, slightly frustrated expression, gesturing with her hands while talking. (3) A series of quick cuts within the car interior follow. The camera remains in a medium close-up on the woman as she reacts to off-camera dialogue. Variety-style captions and colorful comic-book-style graphics, including cartoon characters and food icons, appear around her to punctuate the conversation. (4) The woman laughs heartily, covering her mouth with her hand while squinting her eyes in amusement. The lighting inside the car is bright and even. She occasionally looks out the window, then back at the driver, maintaining a dynamic and engaged physical presence as the text overlays continue to cycle through punchlines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A casual conversation begins with an off-camera male voice complaining about being stuck in parking lot traffic. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar and drum rhythm BGM plays continuously in the background at a moderate volume. (2) A female voice enters the mix, responding with a playful but slightly frustrated tone. The BGM remains steady. (3) A series of puns are exchanged. The male voice asks a question with a clear, inquisitive pitch, followed by the female's guess. Each punchline is punctuated by a crisp 'ding' or comic 'whoosh' sound effect. (4) The female voice erupts into loud, high-arousal laughter after a particularly funny pun. The male voice continues with a higher speech rate, telling two more short 'cold jokes.' (5) The video concludes with the female voice telling the speaker to stop, her tone animated and amused. The BGM fades out abruptly at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by documenting a relatable moment of being stuck in a parking queue and passing the time by telling 'cold jokes' (puns).
